Definition: from G960; a Berœoean or native of Berœa:--of Berea.
BiblicalUsage: Berean — a native of Berea — it shows up only once, in Acts 20:4.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Berean shows how carefully God chose His words — nothing in Scripture is filler.
